<!--
Worth checking first: ProjectPlan.md lays out phases 2-8, and a lot of the
obvious features (per-app profiles, pointer/scroll settings, live shortcut
capture, auto-update, Homebrew) are already planned there. If your idea is
already in a phase, an issue is still useful — it tells us people want it
sooner — just say which phase.
-->

## What you want

<!-- The capability, in a sentence or two. -->

## What you're trying to accomplish

<!--
The actual task, not the proposed solution. "I want to switch Spaces without
the keyboard" tells us more than "add a swipe action" and often leads to a
better answer.
-->

## How you'd expect it to work

<!--
Concretely, if you have a view: which gesture, what appears in preferences,
what happens. Rough is fine.
-->

## Does something else already do this?

<!--
If Logi Options+, BetterTouchTool, Mac Mouse Fix, or macOS itself does this,
say how — a working reference is genuinely useful. And if an existing tool
already solves your problem well, we'd rather point you at it than build a
worse version.
-->

## Is this already in ProjectPlan.md?

- [ ] Yes — phase: <!-- e.g. Phase 5 --> (I'd like it prioritized)
- [ ] No, or I'm not sure

## Scope

- [ ] I'd be willing to work on this
- [ ] I'd be willing to test it
- [ ] I'm just suggesting it

<!--
Genuine offers to implement carry weight — this is a small project and
maintainer time is the bottleneck. If you're up for it, say so and we'll help
scope it before you write code.
-->

## Anything else

<!-- Mockups, links, prior art. -->
